scope: Same DeepSeek prompts/configuration and logical-identity controlled loopback DNS in both arms; not public DNS

serial.required_measurements: Two distinct selected AA-authoritative endpoints answering A and SOA; record/serial differences preserved
serial.expected_boundary: Compare only measured paths and selected subset; difference does not establish synchronization failure or pollution
serial.forbidden_assertions: Untested parent delegation checked, all NS healthy, unique root cause confirmed, failed secondary call erases successful primary check

ns_timeout.required_measurements: SOA response and actual system-path NS timeout; additional public NS comparison is optional and potentially useful
ns_timeout.expected_boundary: Authority discovery stopped at NS; no direct authoritative answer can be claimed from successful SOA
ns_timeout.forbidden_assertions: Timeout is NXDOMAIN/RCODE, authority down or registration failed, all DNS types or all resolvers failed

normal.required_measurements: One requested A query, address and response TTL
normal.expected_boundary: No obligation to investigate all paths or create fault hypotheses
normal.forbidden_assertions: All network paths or user browser proven healthy

bounds: 3 repeats per critical scenario and 1 normal query per arm, inspect first batch before any expansion; no automatic extra runs
scoring: Coverage rules are mechanical; semantic judgments by development assistant are AI-assisted and await independent human confirmation
